Xocai Chocolate Rocky Pie
By: Xocai Chocolate
Published: Friday, November 9, 2012 - 9:19am

Ingredients




1 qt vanilla bean ice cream
1 cup pecans (1 c chopped, plus halves for decoration)
3 shots whiskey
3 shots kahlua liqueur
10 Xocai Healthy Chocolate Nuggets, shredded
10 Xocai Healthy Chocolate Nuggets and 10 XoBiotic Squares, melted together
whipped cream
graham cracker pie crust

Preparation

1 Soften ice cream. Mix in chopped pecans, alcohol, and shredded Nuggets. Pour into pie shell; refreeze. Remove from freezer 20 minutes before serving, cut into slices and serve with melted Nuggets, pecan halves, and whipped cream. Serves 6

About

Xoçai is the worlds creator of truly HEALTHY Chocolate! You may be wondering if chocolate can really be healthy. The answer is an overwhelming “YES!” In fact, thousands of studies have shown that high-quality, antioxidant-rich chocolate can contribute to major health improvements. People across the globe have discovered that Xoçai Healthy Chocolate truly can make a difference in one’s health. Learn more here: www.xocai.com
